# Terminal color schemes from iTerm2-Color-Schemes

A curated selection of 75 terminal color schemes in Konsole
format, taken unmodified from https://github.com/mbadolato/iTerm2-Color-Schemes
at commit 27cbbb5ee7e98ff15484e7342b07a20606260176 (directory `konsole/`). They are licensed under the MIT
license in `LICENSE`.

Refresh or change the selection with `scripts/internal/update-color-schemes.sh`; it
validates every file before keeping it.
